text_block_list.name: Trainer Notes
text_block_list.text:
A notebook arrived for Duramente from her father. 
Written in it was 
the history of her family.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Notes
text_block_list.text:
--Yes, this notebook. It records the path walked 
by people who pressed on, wishing to carry 
Japanese racing to the world.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Notes
text_block_list.text:
Effort, anguish, challenge, defeat... and hope. 
That even if the wish went ungranted now, someone would 
carry the feeling on, so that one day the dream would come true.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Notes
text_block_list.text:
Touching that, Duramente spoke. 
She wanted to shoulder all of it--every feeling and dream 
passed down by her family and by those who love racing.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Notes
text_block_list.text:
And then become the best in the world, and prove herself the "strongest." 
Her eyes, with that resolve settled in them, 
shone with a fierce light--
